title: apply versus save prefer autosave
rule: Apply versus Save; prefer autosave; if not, Save + success/error via message bar or confirmation toast.
pass_when: Apply vs Save is used for the right scope; autosave is preferred; without autosave, Save reports success/error via message bar or confirmation toast.
fail_when: Apply/Save mixed up; no autosave and no success/error after Save.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: Disabled-until-complete as this row (that lock lives on `govuk.dont-use-disabled-buttons` + `fluent.disabled-field-label-stays-perceivable`); `actions.close_saves_separate_cancel` as a merge.
